program.name: Pull-up Volume
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Pull-up supersets for volume, a push and legs day, then heavy pull-ups.
program.about: More pull-ups, spread across the week. The volume day pairs pull-ups with rows and presses in supersets; the push and legs day gives the back a rest; the strength day is straight sets of harder pulls with full rests. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Pull-up volume / push & legs / pull-up strength
